meta.notes: The 12 phase-0 actions per docs/MVP_SCOPE.md §7 (that table is the source of truth for intent types, ticks, checks, failure modes and knowledge produced). Check/roll parameters are v0.1 tunable defaults resolved against rules.json. 'resolver' names the generic core resolver that executes the action (INV-3: the intent-to-code mapping is pack data, never code); movement + wait are executable from iter-1, the remaining ten land with the ActionResolver registry in iter-2. Free-text input never reaches here directly: everything arrives as one of these intents (buttons/commands in phase 0, the C-parser in phase 2).

actions.label: look around
actions.notes: cheap perception of the current location: who/what is present

actions.label: examine
actions.notes: targeted inspection of one entity or spot

actions.label: approach
actions.notes: movement along the location graph (entities.json exits)

actions.label: talk
actions.notes: social exchange; the seed of rumor transfer (accepted faster from trusted tellers)

actions.label: wait
actions.notes: advance N ticks; the world moves while the player stands still

actions.label: take
actions.notes: picking up an item present in the location

actions.label: drop / break
actions.notes: noise on break; a broken fire source near a flammable spot starts fire (rules.json fire)

actions.label: use
actions.notes: context-dependent: ale mug → intoxication, rope → utility, etc.

actions.label: steal
actions.notes: the ev_0007 scenario: failure produces the richest knowledge records in the slice

actions.label: distract
actions.notes: shifts target attention; a method modifier for steal (playscript day1 uses it)

actions.label: set fire
actions.notes: impossible without both requirements (T5); irreversible chain follows (T4)

actions.label: flee
actions.notes: exit under pursuit; guards enqueue chase knowledge records
